hint.en: Learn 11 and 12 (eleven, twelve); 13-19 = unit + -teen, with thir-, fif-, eigh- spelling changes.
hint.ru: 11 и 12 (eleven, twelve) надо выучить; 13-19 = единица + -teen, с изменениями thir-, fif-, eigh-.
hint.uz: 11 va 12 (eleven, twelve) yodlanadi; 13-19 = birlik + -teen, thir-, fif-, eigh- o'zgaradi.

hint.en: Tens end in -ty: twenty, thirty, forty (no u), fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty (one t), ninety.
hint.ru: Десятки оканчиваются на -ty: twenty, thirty, forty (без u), fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty (одна t), ninety.
hint.uz: O'nliklar -ty bilan tugaydi: twenty, thirty, forty (u yo'q), fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty (bitta t), ninety.

hint.en: 21-99 = tens + hyphen + unit, tens first: twenty-one, ninety-nine.
hint.ru: 21-99 = десяток + дефис + единица, десяток первым: twenty-one, ninety-nine.
hint.uz: 21-99 = o'nlik + defis + birlik, avval o'nlik: twenty-one, ninety-nine.

hint.en: Hundreds = unit + hundred, never plural (three hundred); then add the rest: three hundred forty-two.
hint.ru: Сотни = единица + hundred, без -s (three hundred); затем остаток: three hundred forty-two.
hint.uz: Yuzliklar = birlik + hundred, -s yo'q (three hundred); keyin qolgani: three hundred forty-two.

hint.en: 1000 = one thousand or a thousand; after a number thousand stays singular: two thousand.
hint.ru: 1000 = one thousand или a thousand; после числа thousand без -s: two thousand.
hint.uz: 1000 = one thousand yoki a thousand; sondan keyin thousand -s olmaydi: two thousand.
